## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible change and link its requirement or task.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Include failure-path coverage where
relevant and a screenshot for a meaningful UI change.

## Integration and limitations

Note contract changes, migration/rollback needs, and anything simulated,
unverified on hardware, or dependent on external services. Omit irrelevant
sections; keep this proportional to the change.
